name: Sankey Diagram
description: A multi-dimensional Sankey diagram visualization supporting 2-4 categorical dimensions. Ideal for visualizing flow data such as student score progression across testing windows, marketing funnels, user journeys, or any sequential categorical data. Configure dimensions for each stage, add a metric for flow values, and customize colors, labels, and layout through the style panel.

components.name: Sankey Diagram
components.description: Flow diagram showing relationships between 2-4 categorical dimensions with configurable colors, labels, and layout options.
